dataTransform.transform:
[edges.node~>|$|(

  $noData := $isNilOrEmpty(remainingBalance) or $isNilOrEmpty(producedQuantity) or $isNilOrEmpty(scrappedQuantity);
  $noWo := $isNilOrEmpty(workOrderNumber);
  $noRate := $isNilOrEmpty(standardRate);
  {
    "percentComplete": $noData ? "NO DATA" : 
      producedQuantity > 0 and remainingBalance >= 0? 
        $round($sum(producedQuantity/(remainingBalance+producedQuantity)*100),2) & "%" : 
          producedQuantity <= 0 ? "0%" : 
            remainingBalance < 0 ? $round($sum(producedQuantity/(remainingBalance+producedQuantity)*100),2) & "%", 

     "scrapPercent": $noData ? "NO DATA" : scrappedQuantity <= 0 ? "0.00%" : $round($sum((scrappedQuantity/(remainingBalance+producedQuantity))*100),2) & "%", 

     "runTime":  $noRate ? "NO RATE" : 
       $noData ? "NO DATA" : 
       remainingBalance > 0 and standardRate > 0 and producedQuantity = 0 ? $round($sum((remainingBalance/standardRate)+setupRate),2) & " Hrs" : 
       producedQuantity > 0 and remainingBalance >0 and standardRate >0 ? 
         $round($sum(remainingBalance/standardRate),2) & " Hrs" : remainingBalance < 0 ? "OVER PRODUCTION" : 
           remainingBalance = 0? "COMPLETE" : "NO RATE", 

      "requiredQuantity": $noData ? "No Data" : 
        $sum(remainingBalance+producedQuantity) >= 0 ? 
          $sum(remainingBalance+producedQuantity) : 
          0, 

      "estFinish": $noData or $noRate ? "NO DATA" : 
        remainingBalance <= 0 or standardRate <= 0  ? "NA" : 
        remainingBalance > 0 and producedQuantity = 0? ($e:= $sum((remainingBalance/standardRate)+setupRate); $moment().add($e,'hours').format() ) : 
        $coalesce([remainingBalance,0]) > 0 and $coalesce([producedQuantity,0]) >0 ?
          ($r:= $sum((remainingBalance/standardRate)); $moment().add($r,'hours').format()) : 0,

      "producedQuantity": $noData ? "0",
      "workOrderNumber": $noWo ? "No Work Order Loaded",

      "outlook": $isNilOrEmpty(dueAt) ? "#cccccc" : 
         ( $x := dueAt;
        ($moment($x).diff($moment()) > 3600000 ? "#0000dd" : 
        ($moment($x).diff($moment()) > 0 ? "#ffff00" : "#dd0000"))
        ),
        
        
       "lastChange": $isNilOrEmpty(workcenter.currentWorkcenterHistory.id) ? "No History" :
        (
          $t := $coalesce([workcenter.currentWorkcenterHistory.occurAt, workcenter.currentWorkcenterHistory.createdAt]);
          $moment().diff($moment($t),'seconds', true)
        ),

 
       "totalRunTime": $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.runTime) or $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.unplannedDowntime) or $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.plannedDowntime) ? "No Data" :
      $sum(productionSetup.productionRun.runTime+productionSetup.productionRun.unplannedDowntime+productionSetup.productionRun.plannedDowntime+productionSetup.productionRun.changeoverTime),
        
      "crewSize": $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.crewAggregate) or $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.runCrewSize) ? "No Data" :
      (
      $u := $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.crewAggregate) ? 0 : productionSetup.productionRun.crewAggregate;
      $v := $isNilOrEmpty(productionSetup.productionRun.runCrewSize) ? 0 : productionSetup.productionRun.runCrewSize;
      $v & " / " & $u
      ),
      
      "unitsPerHour": $sum(productionSetup.productionRun.totalProduction / (productionSetup.productionRun.runTime/3600)),
      
      "avgCycle": $sum(productionSetup.productionRun.runTime / productionSetup.productionRun.totalProduction),
      
      "runPercent": $sum(productionSetup.productionRun.totalProduction / productionSetup.productionRun.totalRequired)

  }
)|

]

props.description:
Accumulation of production for the duration of this setup.

Quantity Completed

props.description: Accumulation of rejected units for the duration of this setup.

props.description: This is the time that has elapsed since the last time a workcenter history record was created.

props.label: Completed:
props.description: This is the percentage completed, for this output by itself. This number is based upon the total produced that is indicated for each production output

props.label: Scrap:
props.description: Scrap calculated as a percentage of production for each output.

props.description:
Accumulation of production for the duration of this setup.

Quantity Completed

props.description: Quality percentage for the overall run.

props.label: Target Rate/Hr:
props.description: Aggregated target rate (all outputs in the run)

props.label: Time / Unit:
props.description: Seconds Per unit, of the production run overal
